description: This Java source file defines the MediaHandler class, an implementation of ComplexObsHandler responsible for handling media data (audio/video) storage and retrieval for complex observations (Obs) within the OpenMRS platform. It manages media file serialization, mime type detection, and file system interactions for complex Obs objects.

classes.name: MediaHandler
classes.description: A handler class for storing and retrieving media files (audio/video) associated with complex observations in OpenMRS. Implements methods to fetch media data, support views, and save media data to storage.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves the media content for a given observation in RAW view, reading data from storage and attaching it to the Obs object.

methods.name: getSupportedViews
methods.description: Returns the list of supported views, currently only 'RAW_VIEW'.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves the complex data associated with an Obs object to storage, updating the Obs with a reference key.
